description: Build a Trip.com flight search link with route, dates, passengers and cabin pre-filled, for a business trip to or from Japan. Returns a link only: no fares, no booking. Give the user the link exactly as returned, with the disclaimer.

currency.description: Currency shown on Trip.com. Default: CNY for zh, USD for en, JPY for ja.

destination.description: Arrival IATA code. Japan: TYO (all Tokyo airports), HND, NRT, OSA (all Osaka airports), KIX, NGO, FUK, CTS, OKA, SDJ, HIJ.

language.description: Language of the reply (and of the partner page for links): zh = Simplified Chinese, en = English, ja = Japanese. Use the user's language.

origin.description: Departure airport or city IATA code, e.g. PVG or SHA (Shanghai), PEK (Beijing), CAN, SZX, HKG, TPE, ICN, SIN, BKK.

returnDate.description: Return date, YYYY-MM-DD. Omit for a one-way trip.

name: flight_search_link
title: Flight search link (Trip.com)
